name: SCHAFT S-One
summary: A disaster-response humanoid from SCHAFT, a University of Tokyo spin-off, using unusually powerful liquid-cooled electric actuators driven from a capacitor bank rather than hydraulics. S-One posted the top score at the 2013 DARPA Robotics Challenge trials. Google acquired SCHAFT days later; the team withdrew from the 2015 finals and the project was wound down by 2018.
notable: Top score at the 2013 DARPA Robotics Challenge trials
